Translate Panel and Handle 0.99 mm toward the hinge to distribute the available side clearance according to the thick-leaf opening sweep.

Retain frame partition planes under the rigid rotation and all panel, handle and frame collisions. Derive the aperture check from the fitted leaf envelope and the opening stop from collision geometry.
Keep the common closed-unlatched task state and nominal mass/damping/friction; no latch exclusions or test-tolerance changes.
